items.title: Bitcoin Cycle Drawdowns: Peak-to-Trough Recovery Patterns
items.description: Bitcoin's peak-to-trough drawdowns in each cycle since 2011, plotted by days since the peak, with the current cycle from the Oct 6, 2025 high.
items.reason: Bitcoin slid to about $62K this week, down about 29% in under two months, so this shows where the current drawdown sits against past cycles.

items.tab: YTD Performance of Bitcoin treasury companies
items.title: Bitcoin Treasury Companies: 2026 Return YTD
items.description: 2026 year-to-date share-price returns of public bitcoin treasury companies, from Strive and The Smarter Web Company to Strategy, Twenty One, Metaplanet and others.
items.reason: MSTR has dropped sharply from its October highs while Twenty One just added 172 BTC, so the treasury-company scoreboard is in focus.

items.title: Price-to-sales then and now: Cisco from 1998 vs Nvidia and Palantir from 2023
items.description: Price-to-sales then and now: Cisco from January 1998 against Nvidia and Palantir from January 2023, aligned by weeks since start.
items.reason: Nvidia is down more than 40% since early October and the Nasdaq erased its 2026 gains, which revives the Cisco 2000 comparison.

items.title: How stretched are stocks? S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100: % above/below their 200-day moving average
items.description: How far the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 sit above or below their 200-day moving averages, weekly since 2019.
items.reason: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq entered correction territory on Friday's AI-led selloff, and this shows how quickly the cushion over the 200-day has shrunk.

items.title: Starlink capacity per launch: Falcon 9 (27 V2) ~2.6 Tbps vs Starship Flight 14 (26 V3) ~26 Tbps vs a full Starship (60 V3) ~61 Tbps
items.description: Starlink downlink capacity added per launch: Falcon 9 with 27 V2 Minis (~2.6 Tbps) vs Starship Flight 14 with 26 V3s (~26 Tbps) vs a planned full Starship load of 60 V3s (~61 Tbps).
items.reason: Starship Flight 15 reached orbit, deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites and had its upper stage caught by the tower for the first time.
